boundary.description: From M60 Motorway junction 20, E along the Motorway, to the point opposite Manchester Creative & Media Academy. Then E by Victoria Ave East, Moston Lane and Crowden Road to the end of the road, and then by a bee-line across Boggart Hole Clough to the junction of Glen Avenue and Clough Road and by a beeline to the junction of Polefield Road and Charlestown Road and by a bee-line between Dam Head Drive and Earby Grove to a point opposite Churston Ave, and E across White Moss Road, Levedale Road and N along Rochdale Road to the M60 Motorway junction 20.
